name: Residents below the poverty line
source: Census Reporter city profile, reproducing U.S. Census Bureau 2024 ACS 5-year poverty estimate for Carmel-by-the-Sea
notes: The directly opened profile identifies ACS 2024 5-year and reports 6.2% ±3.6 percentage points (195 ±113 people) below poverty for Carmel-by-the-Sea, GEOID 0611250. Tier 1 local searches found no adopted city poverty measure; Tier 2 official Census S1701 table/API was attempted but inaccessible. Census Reporter is a tier-3 secondary interface to Census data; large uncertainty should be considered.

name: Unemployment rate
source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Local Area Unemployment Statistics, retrieved through FRED: Unemployment Rate in Monterey County, CA (annual, not seasonally adjusted)
notes: The directly opened series reports 7.9% for calendar year 2025, updated May 19, 2026. The series notes identify BLS as source, annual frequency, civilian labor force denominator, and the unemployment rate definition. Local tier-1 County 2025–26 Legislative Platform (opened at https://www.countyofmonterey.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/138247/638736919326900000) gives a 2024 annual average rate of 5.2% based on an EDD report; the 2025 BLS series is the newer annual observation. Capture was attempted twice using the approved helper but FRED timed out; snapshot_path is empty and no evidence file was saved. Earlier indexed 2024 candidates of 7.3–7.4% were not used. This is a Monterey County proxy permitted by portrait scale policy; it is not a city-limit rate. Tier 1 County/local searches found a 2024 annual 5.2% candidate; Tier 2 BLS annual series was directly opened and provides the newer 2025 figure. Evidence capture timed out, so the archive is empty.
